_about: Objectives and journal entries are views of story flags. 'start' and 'done' (objectives) and 'when' (discoveries) use the same conditions as dialogue: "flag", "!flag", "flag>=2" or a list of them.

objectives.title: Find out why the bell is silent.
objectives.detail: Pip says Orin went up to the tower yesterday, after shouting at Mara the blacksmith about iron and tuning. Her forge is on the west side of the square.

objectives.title: Learn what Mara's family knows about the bell.
objectives.detail: Mara's family has kept the bell's iron tuning pin for generations. There is a worn patch on it. Some worn things can still be heard: try listening (F) close to it.

objectives.title: Investigate the chapel records.
objectives.detail: Brother Alden keeps Dawnmere's records in the chapel, east of the square. The oldest are sealed behind a door with three seals: flame, moon and crown.

objectives.title: Read the Bellkeeper's Ledger.
objectives.detail: The archive is open. A ledger waits on the lectern inside.

objectives.title: Find a way to reach the bell tower.
objectives.detail: Orin's key opens the north gate. The tower road runs through the mist, and something is guarding it.

objectives.title: Confront the truth of the bell.
objectives.detail: The road is open. Climb the tower and find Orin.

objectives.title: Decide the fate of Dawnmere.
objectives.detail: One more toll will turn the mist away. Somebody has to choose what it costs.

objectives.title: Ask Pip about the old song.
objectives.detail: The ledger's margin holds thirteen marks that rise and fall like a tune. Pip hums a song nobody else remembers.

objectives.title: Ask Orin about Mara's lullaby.
objectives.detail: You promised Mara you would ask.

discoveries.title: Orin's Letter
discoveries.text: "Come home before the thirteenth toll. There is something I need you to remember." It was the only thing he wrote.

discoveries.title: People Forget
discoveries.text: Pip says people forget things after the bell rings. Pip's grandmother used to sing an old tune, but nobody remembers her singing it.

discoveries.title: Names on the Well
discoveries.text: Two names carved into the well: TOBIN and ELSIE. A voice in the stone: "You promised you'd wait for me."

discoveries.title: Thirteen Marks
discoveries.text: The tuning pin bears a bell ringed by thirteen marks. Mara's father taught her that the bell rings only twelve times.

discoveries.title: Mara's Lullaby
discoveries.text: Mara remembers holding her son as a baby. She cannot remember the song she sang him.

discoveries.title: A Hollow Lullaby
discoveries.text: In the forge, the echo of a woman humming over a cradle. The tune itself has been scraped away.

discoveries.title: The Seal Inscription
discoveries.text: "Before the crown, the fire was born. Before the fire, the moon watched alone."

discoveries.title: A Congregation
discoveries.text: In the chapel's echo, the whole village stood together and sang. Not a hymn. Something older.

discoveries.title: The Bellkeeper's Ledger
discoveries.text: "One toll. One cherished memory. The village remains unseen." The bell keeps Dawnmere hidden by taking what its people love.

discoveries.title: The Song Before the Bell
discoveries.text: In the ledger's margin, thirteen marks rise and fall like a melody, above the words: the song before the bell.

discoveries.title: A Kneeling Figure
discoveries.text: "Forgive me. I thought I could choose which memories it would take." It was Orin's voice.

discoveries.title: The Gathering Song
discoveries.text: Pip's grandmother's tune has thirteen notes. Before there was a bell, the whole village sang it together at dusk.

discoveries.title: The Shrine Without a Name
discoveries.text: A mother calling her son home for supper. The name she called has been cut out of the world.

discoveries.title: The Hollow Sentinel
discoveries.text: A boy who guarded the tower road when the first bell was cast. The bell rang, and everyone forgot his name.

discoveries.title: What the Bell Keeps
discoveries.text: Inside the bell: a laugh, a lullaby, two names on a well, a monk tearing pages, a boy who held the road. Everything Dawnmere gave away.

discoveries.title: Orin's Echo
discoveries.text: Night after night, Orin fed the bell his own memories to spare everyone else. Last night it took the last of him.
